title: Rest: a flat landing cut into a round bar (the bar bulges past the sketch plane)

steps.comment: the plane z 16 lies below the bar's crown (z 20): the rest only cuts

expect.note: Bar r 20 x 60 along X = pi 400 60 = 75398.223686.
